hook: This is the USCENTCOM declassification cover sheet recommending public release of a May 2022 Kuwait UAP still-image report, cleared by the DoD Office of Prepublication and Security Review in March 2026.
why_it_matters: The document reveals the formal military chain-of-command pathway by which a UAP observation from a U.S. military system in Kuwait was officially routed to AARO and subsequently cleared for public release. A Major General at the USCENTCOM Chief of Staff level personally endorsed the recommendation, indicating the case was processed at a senior command level rather than quietly suppressed. The batch MDR reference range (25-0094 through 25-0099) suggests this release is part of a coordinated multi-document declassification package rather than a standalone disclosure.

key_findings.finding: USCENTCOM formally recommended this UAP case to AARO through an official military recommendation process, establishing a documented chain of custody from the field to the oversight body.
A Major General serving as USCENTCOM Chief of Staff personally endorsed the recommendation, placing the UAP referral at a senior flag-officer level within the command structure.

key_findings.finding: The declassification spans a block of six consecutive MDR reference numbers, indicating this UAP document is part of a batch release rather than a single isolated record.

The DoD Office of Prepublication and Security Review formally cleared the document for open publication, completing the declassification process approximately five months after the USCENTCOM recommendation.

key_findings.finding: The roughly five-month gap between the USCENTCOM recommendation (October 2025) and the DoD security review clearance (March 2026) reflects a multi-stage review process before public release.

legacy_program_connections.reasoning: AARO is the named recipient of the USCENTCOM recommendation; this document is the formal referral mechanism routing the 2022 Kuwait UAP case to AARO's oversight process.
